entities.summary: El Cid & the High Reconquista, a transformative movement in Spain (1085–1250). Emerged from Alfonso VI of Castile captures Toledo and Covadonga & Northern Christian Kingdoms. Catalyzed Almohad and Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa – turning point of the Reconquista.
